name: Fragdex
description: Sends player connections from each server's chat logs to Fragdex, and shows Fragdex tags and bans in the Live Status player list.

global.label: API key
global.description: A Fragdex API key with Add records and Game server ticked, and nothing else.

global.label: Check Fragdex's HTTPS certificate
global.description: Turn off only if Fragdex uses its own self-signed certificate.

instance.label: Send chat log connections to Fragdex
instance.description: An instance running the fragdex minqlx plugin only sends its history once, since the plugin reports new connections itself.

instance.label: Show the Fragdex column in Live Status
Sent up to
instance.description: Filled in automatically, in the server's local time. Clear it and save to send this server's history again.

global_form.description: Turn this on, then turn it on for each host and each server you want. Only the servers you enable are read.

host_form.description: Allow Fragdex on this host. Each server on it still has its own switch.

instance_form.description: Only connection lines leave the server. Player chat stays on the host.
